lines.text: Let your dog sniff everything, it's reading the news.
Every pole and patch of grass is a message from another dog.
Its nose has around three hundred million scent receptors.
You see, researchers took twenty dogs
and taught them which spot always had a bowl of food,
Then they put a bowl halfway in between.
For two weeks, half the dogs did sniffing games.
The other half just walked at heel, no sniffing allowed.
Afterwards, the sniffers ran to the mystery bowl faster.
The scientists called it more optimistic.
The heel walkers didn't change at all.
